name: Custom Shape Acrylic Magnetic Phone Grip with Rotating Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, magnetic phone grip base, metal ring, and adhesive components, offering a stylish and functional phone accessory with interchangeable charm detail.
    - Made with 3mm acrylic layers, providing a durable structure while keeping the phone grip lightweight and comfortable to use.
    - Includes a strong metal ring and adhesive backing for secure attachment to your phone or phone case.
    - Features a built-in rotating mechanism that allows the charm layer to rotate freely for added movement and playful interaction.
    - Designed to combine grip support, decorative personalization, and magnetic convenience in one compact phone accessory.
    - The layered acrylic construction helps create a more eye-catching finished look with added depth and detail.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main charm size options:
            +) 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm
            +) 2.5 x 2.5 in ~ 6.35 x 6.35 cm
    - Phone grip thickness:
            +) Folded: 0.8 cm
            +) Expanded: 1.7 cm
    - Phone grip base diameter: 5.6 cm
    - Metal ring diameter: 5.5 cm
    📌 Note: The charm dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - One-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a phone grip and a personalized decorative accessory.
    - Helps provide a more secure hold for texting, selfies, video watching, and one-handed phone use.
    - Suitable for use on phones or compatible phone cases with the included metal ring.
    - Great for daily use, gifting, themed accessories, and customized phone decoration.
    - Lightweight, practical, and easy to attach or remove when needed.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun personalized gift for friends, family members, kids, teens, students, pet lovers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, back-to-school, holidays, stocking stuffers, party favors, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves cute personalized accessories and decorative phone add-ons.
    - Great as a custom gift featuring pets, names, characters, hobbies, or themed artwork.
    - A playful gift choice that combines function, style, and personalization 🎁

 

  • How to Use:
    1. Open the package and peel off the adhesive backing from the included metal ring.
    2. Stick it onto your phone or phone case, then remove the protective film.
    3. Attach the phone grip magnetically to the metal ring.

 

PECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Acrylic Magnetic Phone Grip with Rotating Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
